say.speaker: boss
say.text: Heh, three village kids all by themselves, no grown-ups in sight! Fan out and corner them by the spring!

say.speaker: partner
say.text: Keep dreaming! Notice the spring pools, {lord}? As a Water Pokemon, I can cross shallow water tiles that block everyone else!

say.speaker: healer
say.text: And we have tall forest cover right beside us for extra Dodge! Let's drive these thugs away together!
